items.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’m going in on the 19th, the week of the 19th of this month with my nonet.

ctx.x: Yeah, and the people are very nice now. When they first started out they weren’t very nice, but now I guess it’s under new management and they’re very nice. And then Dizzy’s room; they’re nice.
